summary: Load a CSV, edit it as a grid inside Unity, save it back.
overview: A lightweight in-Editor balancing sheet: load a CSV, edit values in a grid, save. It exists so a small tweak does not mean an Excel or Sheets round-trip every time.
useCases: Tweaking balance numbers without leaving Unity.
Reviewing a data file quickly without opening a spreadsheet.
Editing data that is about to be imported into assets.

gotchas.title: It edits the file, not your assets
gotchas.body: Changing a CSV does not update assets already generated from it. Re-run the importer afterwards.
